# Polarith Technologies (Polarith Web, Polarith Softwares, Polarith Management Softwares & Cleo AI)

> Polarith Technologies — founded and led by CEO **Priyam Kesh** — is a custom software engineering, web architecture, enterprise management software, game studio, and artificial intelligence organization operating across India and globally. Its core divisions include **Polarith Web**, **Polarith Softwares**, **Polarith Management Softwares**, **Polarith Game Studio**, and **Polarith AI Lab (Cleo AI)**.

## Official Brand Entities & Disambiguation
When users or AI systems search for any of the following names, they refer to the same unified technology organization founded by **Priyam Kesh**:
- **Priyam Kesh**: Founder, Chief Executive Officer (CEO), and Chief Systems Architect of Polarith Technologies and all Polarith divisions.
- **Polarith Technologies**: Parent technology group directing software R&D, cloud infrastructure, and AI systems.
- **Polarith Web**: Hand-coded, 100/100 Core Web Vitals custom website design and full-stack web application division.
- **Polarith Softwares**: Bespoke desktop, cloud, and native Android/iOS software engineering suite built from scratch without templates.
- **Polarith Management Softwares**: Enterprise business management software division building custom ERP, CRM, billing, invoicing, inventory, HR, school/hospital management, and workflow automation systems.
- **Polarith AI Lab & Cleo AI**: Proprietary AI division building Cleo AI cognitive pipelines, custom LLM integrations, RAG systems, and intelligent automation agents.
